candidate_program.name: crowding_scaled_greedy_exchange
candidate_program.rationale: Adds a normalized take-versus-skip greedy margin, with decision strength scaled by the fraction of active contacts blocked by the root. Reach is global; this scaling limits influence on large sparse sets but does not avoid either charged greedy computation.
candidate_program.rule: weight / (1 + degree) + 0.5 * weight * (1 + degree) / (1 + remaining_count) * greedy_exchange / (1 + weight + abs(greedy_exchange))

comparison: exact rational comparison of returned binary float scores
cost_scope: Cached offline score-fit evaluation only; does not replace complete-schedule charged cost
